senses.gloss: m. (cmp. שַׁבְרִירַיָּא) mullein, a plant the woolly leaves of which are used for wicks (φλόμος λυχνῖτις or θρυαλλίς; v. Löw Pfl., p. 67).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 20b:11">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite>, expl. <he>פתילת המדבר</he> (ed. Sonc. <cite ref="U00810"><he>שִׁיבְרָא</he></cite>, oth. early ed. <cite ref="U00323"><he>שׁוּבְ׳</he></cite>).
